Stories discussed in this episode:

  • Apple reports Q3 2026 earnings: Revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16% year-over-year
  • Apple stock opens down around 10% on mixed Q3 2026 earnings
  • Apple warns supply constraints will 'significantly' worsen next quarter
  • Tim Cook completes final analyst call of his tenure, confirms Ternus will take over
  • App Store regulatory changes are starting to weigh on Apple Services growth
  • Apple's latest acquisition makes a lot of sense for its product roadmap
